verdict.rationale: Segment is a CDP platform (not itself an agent), so an official MCP server is a fair and applicable axis, but no evidence pack item documents a Segment-provided MCP server; the closest item (segment-intdir-1) only shows 'Open in ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor/Perplexity' links on the destination catalog docs, not an MCP server, and probes for llms.txt/docs.md both 404.
